title: Quarterly Sprint Lattice & Cohort Hedging Playbook for Hosted API Model Catalog
creator: Asha Patel
description: Consolidate quarterly planning artifacts into a single sprint-lattice playbook that ties hosted API model catalog rotations to cohort-based canary lanes, capacity hedges, and OKR metrics. This ticket covers a cross-functional campaign to: define the sprint lattice (a 3-track cadence: Fast Experiment, Stable Rotation, Safety Backstop), map model onboarding throughput to capacity commitments, and produce guardrails for canary cohort triggers and rollback windows. The goal is to reduce unexpected model swaps during peak traffic, shorten time-to-onboard for new model variants, and provide product + eng with a predictable runbook for Q2 catalog cadence.
milestones: Milestone 1: Draft sprint-lattice framework & cadence (deliverable: sprint-lattice doc) - 2026-01-22
Milestone 2: Define cohort canary policy matrix (deliverable: canary-policy table and thresholds) - 2026-02-05
Milestone 3: Capacity hedge spreadsheet & cost implications (deliverable: capacity-hedge workbook) - 2026-02-19
Milestone 4: Ops runbook + alerting playbook (deliverable: runbook, dashboard links) - 2026-03-01
Milestone 5: Exec alignment and sign-off; OKR mapping (deliverable: exec slide deck) - 2026-03-08
acceptance_criteria: A1: Sprint-lattice doc published in Confluence with clear owner for each track
A2: Canary policy matrix with numeric thresholds (error-rate delta, latency 95p change, quality regression score) and automated gating in Console
A3: Capacity hedge plan that maps model onboarding throughput to Dedicated capacity buckets with cost delta estimates
A4: Runbook includes play-by-play for failed canary (rollback, fallback variant, incident channel, postmortem owner)
A5: OKR entry created linking initiative to host-api Q2 OKRs with measurable KPIs (model-availability %, median P99 latency, onboarding time)
